name: Complete Paracetamol API Contamination
input_text: ABC Pharma reported visible black particles in Paracetamol API 99.5%, batch PA240812. Manufacturing date was 12 August 2026 and expiry is August 2028. 25 kg is affected.

name: Amoxicillin Damaged Secondary Packaging
input_text: BioHealth Distribution Corp reported damaged cartons and compromised security seals on Amoxicillin Trihydrate 500mg, batch AMX-2026-884. Manufactured on 10 May 2026, expiry May 2029. 350 cartons affected.

name: Ibuprofen Potency OOS Failure
input_text: Nordic Care Pharmaceuticals reported assay potency failure of 72.4% on Ibuprofen DC Granules (Batch IBU-DC-9011, Mfg: 01 June 2026, Exp: June 2029). 1200 kg under quarantine.

name: Metformin Dissolution Failure
input_text: Apex Laboratories flagged dissolution failure in Metformin HCl 850mg (Batch MET-850-2026, Mfg: 15 March 2026, Exp: March 2028). Affected quantity is 80 kg.

name: Ciprofloxacin Sterility Failure (Critical)
input_text: Hospital Central Quality Audit reported microbial endotoxin sterility failure on Ciprofloxacin Infusion batch CIP-STER-099. 450 vials affected.

name: Missing Customer Name
input_text: Customer reported discoloration in Aspirin 100mg tablets, batch ASP-2026-01. 50 boxes affected.

name: Missing Batch Number
input_text: Zenith Pharma reported leaking drums of Glycerin BP. Total 6 drums received with broken bung seals.

name: Ambiguous Dates (Verbal format)
input_text: Global Health Labs received Azithromycin 250mg lot AZI-901 manufactured in mid-July 2026 and expiring by late 2029. 15 kg affected.

name: Multiple Quantities Mentioned
input_text: We ordered 500 kg of Paracetamol API batch PARA-77, but 40 kg was damaged during unloading with black particles visible.

name: Email-Style Complaint Header
input_text:
From: qa@meridianlabs.com
Subject: Defect Notice
To whom it may concern, Meridian Labs rejects Batch MET-500-A of Metformin HCl due to capping in 10000 tablets.

name: Noisy Text with Small Talk
input_text: Good morning team, hope you are having a nice week! Our technician noticed foreign particulate matter in Paracetamol batch PR-991 yesterday morning. 10 kg is set aside. Let's discuss.

name: Glass Fragment in Injectable (Critical)
input_text: St. Jude Hospital found glass particles inside sealed vials of Ciprofloxacin sterile solution, lot CIP-GL-44. 120 vials held.

name: Labeling Print Illegible
input_text: Allied Care reports barcode print illegible on Amoxicillin 250mg cartons, batch AMX-LBL-12. 600 cartons affected.

name: Assay Potency 104.5% OOS
input_text: Quality Control report from Bayer Health: Paracetamol API batch PA-OOS-99 assay potency tested 104.5% against 98.0-102.0% specification. 500 kg quarantined.

name: Crushed Boxes in Transit
input_text: Courier logistics incident: 40 boxes of Ibuprofen tablets batch IBU-BX-01 were crushed during freight transport.

name: Sub-Potent Degradation
input_text: Pfizer QA flagged sub-potent degradation product in Aspirin batch ASP-DEG-88. 30 kg affected.

name: Toxic Impurity Detected (Critical)
input_text: Toxic nitrosamine impurity detected above allowable limit in Metformin HCl lot MET-TOX-01 by Health Authority. Immediate recall for 1500 kg.

name: Administrative CoA Inquiry
input_text: Vertex Health requested an updated Certificate of Analysis for Amoxicillin Trihydrate batch AMX-COA-09. No defect reported.

name: ISO Metric Quantities
input_text: Novartis Logistics confirmed 2.5 metric tons (2500 kg) of Paracetamol API lot PA-NOV-01 has moisture clump defects.

name: Color Variation Yellowing
input_text: Sun Pharma noticed yellow discoloration in Metformin HCl granules batch MET-DIS-02. 75 kg under review.
